summary: The recorded base reproduces the source-side len(None) failure with real four-process Gloo collectives. The exact candidate seeds only the attention-TP rank-zero column across CP before fanning out each TP row, and passes its regression plus independent non-square, empty-payload, TP-only, and CP-only cases.

tests.what_was_measured: Original 2x2 attention TP/CP object-broadcast failure through the real broadcast helper; rank 2 was a TP source with data=None and raised TypeError from len(None).
Candidate regression with real Gloo process groups; the request payload reached all four ranks.
Nine focused broadcast and scheduler integration tests passed.

tests.command: TEST_TP/TEST_CP matrices 2x3, 3x2, 1x3, and 3x1 via torch.distributed.run and adversarial_broadcast.py
tests.what_was_measured: Independent real-Gloo non-square topologies, empty leader payload, CP-only boundary, and TP-only boundary; every rank received the exact payload.

gpu_execution.evidence: The collective defect was exercised with CPU Gloo. One AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU was visible, but the original contract requires an eight-GPU DeepSeek-V4 serving layout and model weights were unavailable.

native_rebuild_reason: Not applicable: the candidate changes Python source and tests only; candidate-files.txt confirms no native source changed.
remaining_limitations: The original eight-GPU DeepSeek-V4 serving command was not run on the single assigned gfx950 GPU.
No DeepSeek-V4 weights were available, so DSV4 model execution and semantic behavior were not evaluated.
NCCL and multi-node behavior were not exercised; validation used the real Python serialization helper over deterministic CPU Gloo process groups.
